sn56.50:1.1: pāsāṇasakkharā → pāsāṇasakkharāti (bj) | sinerupabbatarājāyaṁ → sineru pabbatarājā (sya-all) | satta muggamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā → sattamuggamattiyo pāsānasakkharā (pts) | Sineru → S1 sinerū B2 sinneru as before both always. (pts note) | yam → so B2; B1 sam; missing in S1-3. (pts note) | ṭhapetvā → B2 dhapetvā. (pts note) | sattamuggamattiyo → S3 -mattikāyo. (pts note) | pāsānasakkharā → S1-3 add ti. (pts note)
sn56.50:1.3: vā → ca (sya-all) | parikkhīṇaṁ pariyādinnaṁ → parikkhīṇam pariyādiṇṇam (pts) | kho → missing in S1. (pts note) | yaṁ → S3 ya; missing in S1. (pts note) | yā → S3 has yo corrected from yā. (pts note)
sn56.50:1.5: appamattikā satta muggamattiyo → appamattakā sattamuggamattiyo (pts) | appamattakā → B1-2 -mattikā. (pts note)
sn56.50:1.7: diṭṭhisampannassa → S1-3 -sampanna S3 adding ssa underneath. (pts note) | bahutaraṁ → S1-3 bahutarā taṁ B2 bahutara. (pts note)
sn56.50:1.8: upanidhampi → upanidhimpi (bj) | sattakkhattuparamatā → sattakkhattuṁparamatā (sya-all) | pe → complete in B1-2 till paramatā (S. the preceding sutta). (pts note)
sn56.50:3.2: vālandhakāro → vādondhakāro (bj) | vālandhakāro ca → vālandhakārinaṁ (sya-all) | kūṭaṁ vālandhakāro ca chiggaḷena → kuṭāgārandhakārinaṁ chiggalena (pts) | vālandhakārinaṁ → kuṭaṅgalandhakārinaṁ. ba. kuṭāgārandhakārinaṁ (sya-all: sī.) | Kuṭāgārandhakārinaṁ → S1-3 kūṭaṅgalandha- B2 kuṭāgāranta- (pts note)
sn56.50:3.3: chiggaḷena → chiggalā (bj) | dve → duve (bj) | ca → missing in S1-3. (pts note)
sn56.50:3.4: duveti → dve ti (pts) | Sineru → S1 sinerū B2 sinneru. (pts note) | ti → This Uddāna mentions only nine suttas and among them two chiggala; but there is a third chiggala separated from the others and put before andhakārī. (pts note)
